title: Ad Tracking & Targeted Advertising Risk Calculator
metaDescription: Calculate your risk exposure to ad tracking and targeted advertising. Get personalized recommendations to protect your privacy online.
description: Assess your vulnerability to online ad tracking and targeted advertising based on your browsing habits, device usage, and privacy settings. Get a personalized risk score with actionable recommendations to protect your digital privacy.

formula: const browsing_weight = browsing_frequency * 2; const social_weights = {'none': 0, '1': 10, '2-3': 25, '4-5': 40, '6+': 60}; const shopping_weights = {'never': 0, 'rarely': 5, 'monthly': 15, 'weekly': 30, 'daily': 50}; const cookie_weights = {'strict': 0, 'reject_third_party': 5, 'default': 25, 'accept_all': 40}; let base_score = browsing_weight + social_weights[social_media_usage] + shopping_weights[shopping_frequency] + cookie_weights[cookie_management] + (device_count * 3); base_score -= ad_blocker_usage ? 15: 0; base_score -= privacy_browser ? 20: 0; const risk_score = Math.max(0, Math.min(100, base_score)); const tracking_exposure = Math.min(95, risk_score + 10); let risk_level; if (risk_score <= 25) risk_level = 'Low'; else if (risk_score <= 50) risk_level = 'Medium'; else if (risk_score <= 75) risk_level = 'High'; else risk_level = 'Very High'; return {risk_score, risk_level, tracking_exposure};

educational.methodology: This calculator evaluates your ad tracking risk based on browsing habits, platform usage, privacy tools, and device footprint. It considers factors like social media presence, online shopping behavior, cookie settings, and protective measures to estimate your exposure to behavioral advertising and cross-site tracking.
tips: Install a reputable ad blocker and enable strict tracking protection in your browser settings
Use privacy-focused browsers like a privacy-focused browser or configure mainstream browsers for maximum privacy
Regularly clear cookies and browsing data, or use incognito/private browsing mode
Opt out of ad personalization on major platforms like Google, Facebook, and Amazon
Consider using different browsers or profiles for different activities to limit cross-site tracking

interpretation.label: Low Risk
interpretation.description: Good privacy practices limit your exposure to targeted advertising. Continue using protective tools.

interpretation.label: Medium Risk
interpretation.description: Moderate tracking exposure. Consider implementing additional privacy measures like ad blockers.

interpretation.label: High Risk
interpretation.description: Significant ad tracking exposure. Your online behavior is likely being extensively profiled for advertising.

interpretation.label: Very High Risk
interpretation.description: Maximum tracking exposure. Immediate action needed to protect your privacy from invasive advertising.
